sections.text: مقدمة

This 
 document out lines the major maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed 
 every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.

The pump function is provided with the boilers required fuel and with required 
 pressure.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Dismounting of Screw Pump
Prior to commencing the dismounting.
The following operations must be performed:
Pinch off power supply cable to the motor.
All valves (supply, delivery, steam and condensate) must be closed.
Drain fluid by opening drain plug (use collecting tank)
Let screw pump cool down to ambient temperature.
Dismount motor if need, manometers and manometer lines and take their out.

Dismount of 
the Cartridge Unit

Screw off bolts (52) to dismount pumps cover non drive side (4) from pump 
 casing (1) and take gasket (21) out.

Screw off bolts (51) to dismount the cartridge unit pump from the pump casing 
 (1) and then take it out.
Remove gasket (21) and "يا" الدائري (29).

sections.text: Dismounting of the Bearing Cover and Bearing

With draw coupling half from the driving spindle (12) use 
 manual puller.
Remove key (41) from the driving spindle (12).

Remove cir clip (35) and spacer bush (16) from the driving 
 spindle (12).

Screw off bolts (54) to dismount bearing cover (5) from pump 
 cover drive side (3).

Pull bearing cover (5) over the spindle (12) by using manual 
 puller. Then take gasket (22) = Note: stationary seal ring (83) remain 
 in the bearing cover (5)
Dismount circlip (37) from the bearing cover (5)

Dismount groove ball bearing (34) from the bearing cover (5) 
 by using manual puller and take care to avoid any damages to the stationary 
 seal ring (83)
